title: H · 浅色精密工作台
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one exceptionally polished modern desktop productivity application design screenshot for Git Onboarding, a Chinese Git learning workspace. Landscape 1536x1024 full app screenshot, no perspective/device/wallpaper. Professional mature contemporary software art direction, inspired by real modern shipping productivity tools. This is NOT a retro UI, marketing page, generic admin dashboard, educational poster or giant-text wireframe.
Critical visual scale: a compact 48px topbar, 200px left sidebar, main title only26px and semibold, normal UI labels14–15px with readable charcoal contrast, task prose16px, terminal16px mono with24px line height. Fine typography, consistent icon strokes, small refined controls 32px high, disciplined24px spacing. Do not enlarge every label into bold headings. Use subtle layering, precise alignment, excellent optical spacing. No giant success checkmark or huge footer banner.
Common product content: app brand Git Onboarding, 学习路径, 练习工作台, lesson navigation 01 你的第一次提交 / 02 和队友一起开发 / 03 从容地修正错误; compact page title 你的第一次提交 with small independent mode control 独立挑战 and 重新开始. Show a concise task card 在 README.md 中写下学习记录，然后创建一次提交。 Include readable full editor and full actual terminal, a compact right task/result inspector, native-feeling toolbar. Main editor + terminal should occupy about70% of available workspace. Editor tab README.md, visible 保存 with subtle Ctrl+S hint. Editor content # Git 学习手册 followed by blank line, 学习从这里开始。, blank line, 今天完成了第一次提交。. Editor line numbers only, terminal NEVER line numbers. Terminal 终端 · Bash with just 清屏 control, actual content:
$ git add README.md
$ git commit -m "记录学习成果"
[main 11a701f] 记录学习成果
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)
$ git status
On branch main
nothing to commit, working tree clean
$
Inspector section 本次任务 with mission, lower section 检查结果 with small success icon 本关已完成, 2/2 条件通过, checks README 修改已提交 and 工作区与暂存区干净, evidence main · 11a701f and 刚刚检查, modest secondary 再次检查 button and primary 下一关 → button followed by next lesson caption 协作与冲突. Small 本地环境已就绪 dot in bottom chrome. Font control 字号 100%. No invented metrics, no avatars, no AI chat features, no charts, no extra account/login/settings inventory. No huge course numbers, no poster typography, no thick rules, no bevels, no serif, no pixel fonts, no green dominant palette. Typography should suggest real carefully typeset interface, modern Chinese sans akin PingFang/Noto Sans SC and Latin Inter with regular/medium/semibold limited weights, mono solely in code. Render all Chinese legibly.
Specific inspiration and visual reasoning: Linear March2026 design refresh, reduce navigation attention, soften boundaries, consolidate controls. Adapt the principles to original Git learning app; don't copy Linear logo or exact branded UI. Light nearwhite #FCFCFD main on very light neutral #F5F5F6 sidebar; borderless subdued selected sidebar row #E9E9EE, darkgray regular text, tiny muted violet active indicator. Central integrated workspace with rounded10px top-corner white surface and subtle hairline edges. Editor above and terminal below in same continuous central surface, split horizontally with one thin divider; use a LIGHT terminal white/gray with restrained green prompt and black commands so there is no giant black rectangle. Right inspector width270px, quietly separated by thin gray line, typography-led task summary and compact results, no box inside box. A small muted periwinkle #6666D8 next lesson button with white text; other accents minimal. Icon sizes16px, crisp 1.5px outline. Small breadcrumb 学习路径 / 入门 / 练习01 in topbar. Remove visually heavy top-level tabs from content, put navigation appropriately in sidebar. Very restrained shadows, warm-neutral grayscale depth, mostly unboxed content, high-quality editorial precision WITHOUT serif or huge text. Contemporary Linear-quality app screenshot. Sparse but usable, no decorative shapes.
